_comment: Lang fragment of the Hub economy (elite/hub, 1.83.0). Merge into assets/nusmp/lang/en_us.json at release; the messages also carry the same English text as their fallback in code, so nothing is blank before the merge, but item and entity names need these keys.
item.nusmp.dungeon_map.tip1: Use it inside the Mega-Dungeon to reveal the layout of the floor you stand on.
item.nusmp.dungeon_map.tip2: Rooms you have walked through are marked.
message.nusmp.hub.map.nothing: The map shows nothing here. Use it on a floor of the Mega-Dungeon.
message.nusmp.hub.map.off: The map is blank: the Dungeon Map is switched off on this server.
message.nusmp.hub.quest.off: The Quest Giver has nothing for you today.
message.nusmp.hub.quest.unknown: That quest is no longer on offer.
message.nusmp.hub.quest.done: You have already done that quest%s.
message.nusmp.hub.quest.full: You cannot carry more quests (the limit is %s).
message.nusmp.hub.quest.locked: That quest is not open to you yet.
message.nusmp.hub.quest.not_offered: That quest is not on today's board.
message.nusmp.hub.quest.not_active: You have not accepted that quest.
message.nusmp.hub.quest.not_ready: That quest is not finished yet.
message.nusmp.hub.shop.unknown: The Merchant does not sell that.
message.nusmp.hub.shop.locked: The Merchant will not sell you that until you have reached floor %s.
message.nusmp.hub.shop.sold_out: You have bought all of that the Merchant will sell you today.
